meta.name: motion-graphics
meta.description: A short, design-led motion graphic where motion is the message — kinetic typography, stat count-up, chart/data-viz hit, logo sting / brand lockup, lower-third / callout / social overlay, animated map (highlight regions, connect places, zoom to a location), animated tweet / news-article / headline, webpage / UI animation (scroll, cursor, callouts), or fusing a real image's geometry into a chart. Usually under 10s (up to ~30s), no narration or live-action subject; renders to MP4 or transparent overlay. Longer / narrated / multi-scene → /general-video. Unclear → /hyperframes.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 创建动画文本、图表、地图或UI动画等动态图形短片。
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需快速制作无旁白的动态图形视频。
copy.tagline_en: Create kinetic typography, data charts, map animations, or UI motion graphics in seconds.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to produce short, design-led motion graphics without narration.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 能根据你的描述自动制作短动画——包括动效文字、数字跳动、图表动画、Logo 出现、地图动画、网页/UI 动效等。它会规划、搜集素材、设计、构建、验证并渲染成 MP4 或透明 Overlay 视频，整个过程只需你提供内容或简单描述。
howto.when: 当你请求制作一个简短（通常 10 秒以内）的、以动效为主的动画，且不需要旁白或真人拍摄时触发。如果任务更长或有旁白，它会改用其他技能；不确定时会先询问你。

say.text: 帮我做一个公司Logo出现的动画。
say.note: Claude会规划并生成Logo揭示动画。

say.text: 把这句话做成动效标题：'2025年销量翻倍'。
制作一个柱状图动画，展示过去五年营收。

howto.what_en: This skill lets Claude create short motion graphics — kinetic typography, stat count-ups, charts, logo reveals, maps, UI animations, and more. It autonomously plans, sources assets, designs, builds, verifies, and renders an MP4 or transparent overlay video, given a user's description or content.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask for a short (under 10s), design-led, unnarrated motion graphic. If longer or narrated, it routes to another skill; if unclear, it asks first.

say_en.text: Create a logo reveal animation for my brand.
say_en.note: Claude plans and renders a logo sting.

say_en.text: Make a bar chart animation showing revenue for the past 5 years.
